\subsection{Full Quantitative Steering Results}
\label{sec:full-quantitative-results}
Tables~\ref{tab:quantitative-alpha-all} and~\ref{tab:quantitative-beta-all} list all configurations for additive alpha steering and band capping, respectively. The MRR and MCS entries are differences from each experiment\textquotesingle s own unsteered baseline, rather than absolute scores. Each entry averages 96 persona--question pairs, giving every question and persona equal weight. General word banks depend only on the persona; contextualized banks also depend on the question. The complete-only policy retains target words represented by a complete token; the proxy-inclusive policy also permits a representative token for a multi-token target word. All twelve questions are included.
